glyph.isekai_mahou.rock.desc: Hurls a heavy rock: high physical damage and knockback.
glyph.isekai_mahou.raise_pillar.desc: A stone pillar bursts from the ground, lifting whoever stands on it. Crumbles after a while.
glyph.isekai_mahou.stalagmite.desc: A stone spike erupts beneath the target: damage, knock-up and slowness.
glyph.isekai_mahou.stoneskin.desc: Skin hardens like rock: armor, Resistance and knockback resistance.
glyph.isekai_mahou.excavate.desc: Breaks a 3×3 area of dirt and stone. Works with Fortune and Silk Touch.
glyph.isekai_mahou.fertilize.desc: Earth energy makes nearby plants grow, like bone meal. Baby animals grow up instantly.
glyph.isekai_mahou.stone_wall.desc: Raises a temporary wall between you and the target.
glyph.isekai_mahou.root.desc: Roots bind the target to the ground: it can't walk or jump.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quicksand.desc: The ground turns into quicksand: the target sinks, gets stuck and runs out of breath.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_golem.desc: Summons an allied Stone Golem that guards you and taunts your enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.fortress.desc: A stone dome closes around the target: shelter for you, a prison for enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tremor.desc: The earth quakes: grounded enemies around take damage and are stunned.
glyph.isekai_mahou.weight.desc: Makes the target heavy: slow, unable to jump and taking more fall damage. Grounds fliers.
glyph.isekai_mahou.magnetism.desc: Pulls items to you and drags enemies wearing iron armor or wielding iron weapons.
glyph.isekai_mahou.earthsplitter.desc: Legendary. Tears open a fissure in a line that swallows enemies, then slams shut, crushing anyone left inside.
glyph.isekai_mahou.wind_blade.desc: A sharp blade of wind. With Sensitive, it cuts leaves, grass and cobwebs.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gust.desc: A powerful blast of wind that sends the target flying.
glyph.isekai_mahou.impulse.desc: Launches the target where you are looking. On yourself, it becomes an air dash.
glyph.isekai_mahou.double_jump.desc: Lets you jump again in mid-air for a while.
glyph.isekai_mahou.glide.desc: Fall slowly and glide where you look. Sneak to drop normally.
glyph.isekai_mahou.whirlwind.desc: A vortex pulls nearby enemies in and spins them around.
glyph.isekai_mahou.launch.desc: A column of wind hurls the target into the air.
glyph.isekai_mahou.swiftness.desc: The wind carries you: run faster and step up blocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_sylph.desc: Summons an allied Sylph that grants you speed and cuts enemies with wind.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tornado.desc: Creates a tornado that chases enemies, sucking them in and lifting them up.
glyph.isekai_mahou.vacuum.desc: Removes the air from a point: everything is pulled to the center and those inside suffocate.
glyph.isekai_mahou.deflect.desc: A wind barrier sends arrows and projectiles back at whoever shot them.
glyph.isekai_mahou.silent_steps.desc: Mobs that aren't close can't notice you, and your vibrations go unheard.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sonar.desc: A wave of wind reveals every creature in a wide radius.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tempest.desc: Legendary. Summons a local storm with raging winds and lightning striking your enemies.
